statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41650 is a comment and CDATA injection in the fast-xml-parser XMLBuilder when user controlled data is written into XML comments or CDATA sections. The image ships fast-xml-parser 4.5.7 under the minio client, which the director uses only to create presigned upload URLs and which parses S3 responses rather than building XML from request data. The fix is 5.7.0, a major upgrade minio 7 does not accept. Waiting for a compatible upstream fix.
